caption: A chainsaw is revved in a garage, and the tools hanging on the pegboard behind it sway and tap against the board.

sa.check: A chainsaw in a garage, in front of a pegboard hung with tools.
The chainsaw is revved: its chain runs or the saw shudders.
The tools sway and tap against the board.
The tools stay on their pegs.
The revving comes first and the swaying follows.

pc.expect: The tools hang still until the saw runs and settle if it stops.
pc.fail: Tools sway before the saw starts; or go on swaying after the saw has stopped and settled; or a tool slides along the pegboard from one peg to another.

pc.expect: While the saw runs the tools stir and each swing brings them back against the board.
pc.fail: The saw shudders for a spell and every tool hangs dead still; or the tools swing away from the board and stay held off it; or a tool swings out from the board and hangs in the air.

pc.expect: The tools hang down from their pegs and at rest hang straight.
pc.fail: A tool rests tilted with nothing touching it; or rises up the board; or a tool that leaves its peg floats rather than falling.

pc.expect: The tools and the pegboard are rigid; the sway is a swing on the peg.
pc.fail: A wrench bends; or the pegboard ripples; or a tool's handle stretches.

pc.expect: The tools keep their count; one chainsaw; nothing passes through the board.
pc.fail: A tool appears or vanishes; or a tool passes through the board; or two tools merge; or the chainsaw duplicates.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tools' colours, the pegboard's colour and the saw's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: Tools change colour; or the pegboard changes colour; or the saw changes colour.

note: The person revving the saw is a trigger and is not judged.
